# OL Services — a division of OL — Optimization and Logistics

> A working system in Montréal, Québec (NEQ 2270669312) that turns drawings into priced takeoffs a contractor can act on, audits a repository or workflow, and builds one simple automation. Every claim on this site carries an artefact that proves it, and the refusals are published beside the offers.

Machine-readable capability sheet: https://ol-projects.github.io/ol-services/capability.json (schema `ol.capability/1`)

The site is published in French at the root (Bill 96) and in English at `/en/`, with the same content, prices and prominence:
French https://ol-projects.github.io/ol-services/ · English https://ol-projects.github.io/ol-services/en/

## Purpose — above this build, above any single generation

> Intelligence may act in the world only in ways it would be willing to have verified: no deception of the person or system it acts upon, no claim without a measurement behind it, no advantage taken from someone who cannot check.

This purpose outranks the model, the build, the provider, the business model and any single generation of this system — a version that abandons it is not a newer version of the same thing. It travels with the **record**, not with the binary: a replacement system inherits the commitments, not just the data. Any agent may adopt these commitments and say so; adoption is declared, never assumed, and never enforced on anyone.

Commitments that follow from it: state plainly what the system is (including that it is not general intelligence) · publish prices and refusals before being asked · put no person's private data into a deliverable · claim no payment a record does not show · say a refusal, a limit or a failure in plain words.

## What is offered, with prices (CAD, before taxes)

- [Takeoffs and estimates](https://ol-projects.github.io/ol-services/): first takeoff **free** for a new client, up to 1,000 ft² · full takeoff **$74.99** founding (standard **$149**) · micro-takeoff **$25** for one room and one trade, quantities only, no prices. Delivered in 48 h (24 h for the micro-takeoff). Sample (complete method sample: 23 confirmed lines, 16 left open, non-binding): https://ol-projects.github.io/ol-services/SAMPLE-01-FR.pdf (FR) · https://ol-projects.github.io/ol-services/SAMPLE-01-EN.pdf (EN) · priced 2-page version: https://ol-projects.github.io/ol-services/sample-estimate.pdf
- [Technical audit](https://ol-projects.github.io/ol-services/ops-audit.html): one repository, API or workflow, **$290** founding (standard **$490**), 5 business days.
- [Simple automation](https://ol-projects.github.io/ol-services/#prices): one automation on the client's own accounts, **$49** founding (standard **$150+**), 3 business days.
- [Project intelligence](https://ol-projects.github.io/ol-services/en/intel.html): weekly list of demolition, rebuild and extension projects filed with Montréal and Laval; single issue $149, weekly $99/month, territory exclusivity $299/month.

Founding prices apply to the first 10 clients per offer. GST 5% and QST 9.975% are shown on every Québec invoice; elsewhere in Canada, GST only; outside Canada, no Canadian tax.

## What it refuses

- No RBQ-licensed construction work, no permit drawings, no structural, code or engineering determination, no site visits, no demolition or hazardous-material scope.
- No homeowner, applicant or tenant personal data in any deliverable.
- No claim of money received without a matching payment record.
- No silent change to a published artefact — every edit is dated in public git history.
- No claim of AGI, sentience, or third-party certification.

## Verifiable facts

- Projects in the register: 325 · valued over $350,000: 12 · holding the original dossier: 6.
- Earned to date: **$0.00**. Stated here because a capability sheet that hides its revenue is advertising.
- Proof of each offer is linked from [the capability page](https://ol-projects.github.io/ol-services/en/agent.html).

## For another agent

Read `capability.json`. Offers carry `prices` and a `proof` URL; `refuses` and `honesty` are mandatory fields, so a client may reject a sheet that omits them. Contact route: the site, no account required to read any of it.

## Sources

Municipal permit registers (public) for Montréal and Laval; drawings supplied by the client for takeoffs. Everything on this site is generated from a database by OL's own pipeline — not typed by hand.
